recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全由單一型態的母細胞取代：中到大型、核質比高、染色質細緻、核形略不規則，細胞質淡藍且完全無顆粒或 Auer 小體；型態上看不出分化方向，須靠 MPO/NSE 陰性及流式缺乏系別標記才能歸為未分化型。
features: Sheet of monotonous intermediate to large blasts replacing normal elements
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to angulated, slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
No Auer rods, granules, or vacuoles
Rare residual granulocyte at top; smudged cells and platelets in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of intermediate to large blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant to moderate agranular pale-blue cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent, and residual maturing hematopoietic elements are rare. The morphology does not indicate lineage. With negative myeloperoxidase and nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and absence of lineage-specific markers by flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are MPO negative by cytochemistry but express at least two myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33, or CD117, unlike AUL.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61, which should be tested before diagnosing AUL.
Lymphoblasts are also MPO/NSE negative but express B (CD19, cCD79a, CD10) or T (cCD3) lineage markers.
BPDCN expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 and often presents with skin lesions.
